title: Chatbot AI trở thành một kênh tiếp nhận tin tức
subtitle: AI chatbots are becoming a news access point

questions.en: In its 2026 report, Reuters Institute describes emerging use of AI chatbots for news and finds that trust in chatbots is associated with greater likelihood of using them for news.
